chunks: the man who urinates, then performs istinjāʾ, then afterward sees moisture: “If, when he urinates, he presses what is between the anus and the testicles three times, and massages what is between them, then performs istinjāʾ, then if that flows until it reaches the thighs, he need not worry.”

key_terms.فَخَرَطَ: he presses or draws the hand along the passage to expel remaining fluid
key_terms.يَسْتَنْجِي: he performs istinjāʾ, cleansing the private parts after relieving oneself

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man notices wetness after urination and istinjāʾ?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning moisture seen after urination and istinjāʾ. It states that if a man performs the described pressing and massage before istinjāʾ, then later wetness is not to be treated as problematic, even if it extends to the thighs.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.148 - Another narration (by Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) ) states:

In the case of a man who urinates, performs istinja (cleansing of private parts), and then notices wetness afterward: 'If he, after urinating, presses the area between the anus and the testicles three times and massages it, then performs istinja, he need not worry even if wetness flows down to his thighs.'.
